Title: Ishaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ishaan - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Riya - 10 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Neeta - 40 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Neeta and Riya stand near him.]

Neeta: "Let's do something fun today."

[The sun rises over the village.]

Ishaan: "Oh wow!"

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Ishaan (laughing): "Hey, look at that!"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Riya: "How beautiful!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Ishaan: "Oh wow!"

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Riya (gently): "I'm ready!"

[The sun is blazing and Ishaan is sweating.]

Ishaan: "Mom, look at this."

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Ishaan stands by the road. Neeta and Riya stand near him.]

Ishaan: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan gets on the bus.]

Ishaan (softly): "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan gets off the school bus.]

Neeta (softly): "What happened?"

[Ishaan pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Ishaan: "Oh wow!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Riya and Neeta stand near him.]

Riya: "Look over here."

[Ishaan puts on his school uniform.]

Ishaan: "And then?"

[Ishaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Ishaan: "Careful!"

[Ishaan puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Riya (softly): "What next?"

[Riya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Neeta (softly): "And then?"

[Riya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Riya (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
